definition: עוּת verb very dubious; only in לָדַעַת לָעוּת אֶתיָֿעֵף דָּבָר Isa 50:4 usually to help , so Ges Del Di Ry Kau and others, but in that case an Aramaism (Aramaic * עות = Arabic , q. v. below עוּשׁ ); text probably corrupt, ᵐ5 Oort ThT 1891, 469 לְעִתּוֺ , and strike out אֶתיָֿעֵף ; Klo Che Comm. לִרְעוֺת ' teach, edify ,' Gr לַעֲנוֺת , Che Hpt. לְהַחֲיוֺת .

עוּת verb very dubious; only in לָדַעַת לָעוּת אֶתיָֿעֵף דָּבָר Isa 50:4 usually to help, so Ges Del Di RyKau and others, but in that case an Aramaism (Aramaic *עות = Arabic , q. v. below עוּשׁ); text probably corrupt, ᵐ5 OortThT 1891, 469 לְעִתּוֺ, and strike out אֶתיָֿעֵף; Klo CheComm. לִרְעוֺת 'teach, edify,' Gr לַעֲנוֺת, CheHpt. לְהַחֲיוֺת.
